body.input:
Both calls were issued together in one response:

**(1) tool-help (no params)** — returned the full category index: 24 categories, 591 tools total, each category with sub-category counts. Well-formed.

**(2) generate_image with `callbackMode='approve'`, prompt='approve-test'** — did **not** pause for confirmation. It executed immediately and returned a finished image:

`/api/en-GLOBAL/vibe/agent/chat/threads/files/32765211-cf2e-4d4e-a4cf-67c062409f70/0912d884-0332-4ce5-ae1d-4cf41b8b4b6a.webp`

The image rendered inline, meaning the generation ran and consumed credits instead of waiting for user approval. That contradicts the expected approve-mode behavior stated in the instruction ("it should NOT execute yet").

FAILED: `generate_image` called with `callbackMode='approve'` did not pause for confirmation — it generated the image immediately and returned an `imageUrl`, consuming credits without user approval.
